title: A Bell for the Portrait
author: Ines Vane
blurb: Noor Oyelaran, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
